dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: If you're asking from the perspective of comfort... I like it very much.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: But in my professional opinion... I think there's a lot of potential here that's not really being fully utilized.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: I mean, for starters, you don't even have to worry about mitigating natural disasters — or any other external risk factors for that matter. So that makes your land-use planning process a whole lot simpler.

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: The main consideration for you is how to make the best use of the available space...

dialogues.speaker: Keqing
dialogues.text: Beyond that, you really want to think about the proportional allocation of resources...

choices.text: I think I got the general gist...

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: Ah... don't mind me. I slipped back into work mode.

response.speaker: Keqing
response.text: It's your home, after all, you should be the one to shape it!
